title: Clear planning barriers to new supermarkets and give shoppers better price information
action: Remove planning and zoning rules that keep new supermarkets out (such as limits based on the number of shops or distance from rivals), and require clearer information on prices, price trends, promotions and loyalty programs.
why: Two chains hold most of the market; easier entry for rivals and better price information are the levers most likely to sharpen competition.

evidence.source: Cracking down on the supermarkets to get a better deal for Australians (media release, 21 March 2025)
evidence.quote: Addressing planning and zoning issues to reduce barriers to entry and enhance competition

evidence.source: Cracking down on the supermarkets to get a better deal for Australians (media release, 21 March 2025)
evidence.quote: Giving consumers more information about prices, price trends and promotions and loyalty programs to help them find the best value.

evidence.source: Competition Policy Review: Final Report (Harper review)
evidence.quote: Proximity restrictions on particular types of retail stores are not a relevant planning consideration.

progress.what: The Government agreed in principle with the ACCC's 2025 recommendations and released guidelines for best practice in commercial planning and zoning.
